variants.name: -S で規則を書いた形で見る・同じ規則を書いて消す

look: ip netns exec outside curl -k https://shop.example/
dnat: iptables -t nat -D PREROUTING -i eth0 -p tcp --dport 443 -j DNAT --to-destination 192.168.1.11:443
iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -i eth0 -p tcp --dport 443 -j DNAT --to-destination 192.168.1.10:443
forward: iptables -A FORWARD -i eth0 -o eth1 -p tcp -d 192.168.1.10 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
ip netns exec outside curl https://shop.example/

variants.name: 規則を置き換える・NEW だけ通す

dnat: iptables -t nat -R PREROUTING 1 -i eth0 -p tcp --dport 443 -j DNAT --to-destination 192.168.1.10:443
forward: iptables -I FORWARD 2 -p tcp -d 192.168.1.10 --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -j ACCEPT
ip netns exec outside curl -s https://203.0.113.5/

input: iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -i eth0 -p tcp --dport 443 -j DNAT --to-destination
